svg.title: Mensageiro de Memórias
svg.desc: Ilustração original do desafio Mensageiro de Memórias.
svg.metadata: {"generator": "image_gen built-in", "prompt": "Use case: illustration-story. Use the attached illustration ONLY as a STYLE and CHARACTER REFERENCE: the same premium detailed pixel-art look, crisp small pixels, nuanced dithering, dimensional lighting and cozy Brazilian indie-adventure atmosphere. Retain the SAME Black teenage heroine: dark brown skin, short voluminous curly afro, lavender purple jacket, cream shirt, navy trousers and white-soled sneakers. Create ONE wholly new finished VOICES challenge cover, replacing the whole setting, composition and action with the described scene. Panoramic landscape 20:9, around 1870x841, for a small 640x288 game-selection card. Rich but readable focal hierarchy, clear gameplay storytelling and strong silhouettes. Keep all primary action within the central 75 percent height. No text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, HUD, borders or UI screenshots. No photorealism, smooth vector shapes or toy 3D. Challenge: Mensageiro de Memórias. A playful stealth rescue mission in a neighborhood archive courtyard at indigo night. The heroine, holding a small satchel containing a warm glowing historical book, peeks around a low hedge-covered stone wall in the left foreground. On the right, a friendly but vigilant archive caretaker patrols with an amber lantern; a clearly visible softly glowing circular detection zone lies on the paving around the caretaker. A safe path behind the wall leads toward an inviting archive doorway with book shelves faintly visible through its warmly lit window. Additional scroll boxes, a flowering vine, cobbled walkways, low hedge walls and tile-roofed cottages give the courtyard depth. Suspenseful but cozy and child-appropriate: no weapons, no police, no aggression or horror. Moonlit teal and navy, lantern gold and lavender accents, intelligent hiding action, strong clear foreground silhouettes. No text or arrows."}
